[EVENT] User is thinking of making a big batch of pasta sauce and freezing it for future use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to properly freeze and reheat pasta sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for freezing include cooling the sauce, portioning it into airtight containers, labeling and dating, and using freezer-safe containers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for reheating include thawing in the refrigerator, reheating slowly over low-medium heat, adding liquid if thickened, and tasting to adjust seasoning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that frozen pasta sauce can be stored for up to 6 months.
